description: Defines a specialized vector class for int64_t using VSX instructions, including vector operations, blending, loading, storing, and arithmetic operators.

classes.name: Vectorized<int64_t>
classes.description: A vector class for int64_t optimized with VSX instructions, supporting various vector operations and blending.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the vector (fixed at 4).

methods.name: loadu
methods.description: Loads vector data from memory, with optional count for partial loads.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores vector data to memory, with optional count for partial stores.

methods.name: angle
methods.description: Computes the angle of the vector, used in complex number operations.

methods.name: real
methods.description: Returns the real part of the vector (identity for real vectors).

methods.name: imag
methods.description: Returns the imaginary part of the vector (zero for real vectors).

methods.name: conj
methods.description: Returns the conjugate of the vector (identity for real vectors).

methods.name: abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of each element.

methods.name: neg
methods.description: Returns the negation of each element.

methods.name: blend
methods.description: Blends two vectors based on a compile-time mask.

methods.name: blendv
methods.description: Blends two vectors based on a runtime mask.

methods.name: arange
methods.description: Creates a vector with a range of values starting from a base, with a specified step.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets elements of a vector based on count.
